At the Antimonopoly Law Study Group (December session) organized by the Kyoto Comparative Law Center, I gave a presentation on the EU's Post Danmark I case under the title "A Case on Whether Selective Price Cuts Constitute an Exclusionary Abuse."

Citation: Case C‑209/10 Post Danmark A/S v Konkurrencerådet (Post Danmark I) \[2012\] ECR I-000.
